# wisp-science v1.17.0 — Research Assistant

**Keep one conversation for your research plans, delegate work to projects, and receive the results on your desktop or in WeChat.**

The new **Research assistant** brings project activity, saved plans and task dispatch into one persistent conversation. Ask what happened this week, record today's priorities, or send a concrete task to a project conversation. The assistant coordinates the work; project agents perform the analysis. This release also adds daily research recaps, an Automation page, configurable hooks, and improvements to conversation controls and the native desktop previews.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel; compatible installations can update in-app.
- **macOS SwiftUI Preview**: separate signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel, each with a SHA-256 checksum.
- **Windows**: MSI and NSIS installers. Windows release signing is currently disabled, so these installers remain unsigned.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.

Installers will appear in Assets as the platform builds finish. The Windows WinUI 3 preview remains available through native-preview workflow artifacts or a local source build; it does not replace the regular Windows installer.

## Research assistant

- Open **Research assistant** from the home screen, replacing the former scratch-chat entry. It keeps one ongoing conversation across projects, with independently collapsible project and calendar sidebars. Narrow windows use drawers.
- Ask for recorded progress across visible projects, or select one project to include its saved conversations in subsequent questions. Projects hidden by privacy mode remain unavailable to the assistant.
- Save dated plans with open, done or dropped states. Unfinished items carry forward to today, and plans survive conversation compaction.
- List project conversations, continue an existing conversation or create one for a task. A requested server can become that conversation's default execution context before dispatch; a busy conversation is not interrupted or rebound.
- Once a project agent accepts the task, the assistant acknowledges startup and becomes available again. When the project turn ends, a background summary reports the result, output files, failures and unfinished work in the assistant conversation.
- Project approvals for dispatched work are reviewed against the original request. Clear operations within that request can be approved once; uncertainty or incomplete details are forwarded to you. Assistant Full Permission does not grant project-wide permission.

The assistant does not itself edit files, run commands or search literature. Those actions belong to the project agents it dispatches. See the [research assistant guide](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.17.0/docs/research-assistant.md) and [tutorial](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-research-assistant.html).

## WeChat access

- **Research assistant → Remote access** provides its own opt-in WeChat iLink binding. Messages reach the same assistant conversation without switching projects with slash commands.
- This binding is independent from the project bot in Settings. A bot can belong to only one entry at a time, and only its bound owner's private messages are accepted.
- Reply `yes` or `no` to the current approval, use `full` / `full off` for the assistant conversation's temporary Full Permission, and use `/approval` to show a pending request again. Full Permission resets when Wisp restarts.
- Tasks started through WeChat send their completion summaries back to the original binding. `/status`, `/help` and `/stop` stay within the assistant entry.

Keep Wisp running for remote access and completion callbacks. If iLink's reply window expires, the summary is saved on the desktop and queued for the next message on the same connection. Quitting Wisp or unbinding can discard pending in-memory notifications. A finished agent turn is not proof that a separately submitted long-running job has finished.

## Recaps, automation and hooks

- The new **Automation** page brings project schedules and daily research recaps together. Create daily, weekly or interval tasks, pause them, or run them immediately.
- Daily recap automation is on by default at 09:00. It drafts missing recaps for recorded activity in the last three complete days, catches up after a missed run, and leaves existing or dismissed recaps alone. Drafts require review before becoming confirmed research records.
- Archive and Recap can use their own specialist-bound models. Archive review can minimize while preparation or confirmation continues.
- **Settings → Hooks** manages built-in and command hooks. Project `.wisp/hooks.json` files require explicit trust of their current contents; edits require renewed trust. Hooks support JSON decisions, and a failed `PreToolUse` hook blocks the tool call.

Schedules run while Wisp is open; they are not an operating-system background service.

## Conversation and desktop improvements

- Unsent drafts stay with their own conversation. Failed assistant sends preserve the draft and selected project.
- A separate thinking-effort control uses exact model capabilities. Send/Stop controls, side-chat icons and composer menus are more consistent; narrow toolbars fold actions into More.
- Clicking a ready attachment opens its preview. Conversation artifact files can be moved or deleted through a preview of the affected files.
- Shelved conversations can be filtered out of search and restored later. Command and search palettes now share more consistent styling and keyboard hints.
- Fixed macOS arrow keys inserting control characters in the composer, legacy database columns blocking project creation, and an unavailable project database blocking otherwise healthy conversations.
- Added official **Sign in with ChatGPT**, while retaining the Codex login as a legacy option.
- Refreshed the bundled models.dev catalog used by offline builds and exact model-capability lookup.
- SwiftUI preview fixes improve code highlighting and usage rendering. WinUI 3 improvements cover host startup, project navigation feedback, conversation reading, panels, Run review and composer options.
- Optional `desktop_autopilot` connects TypeSafe Jev decisions to Cua Driver when both the credential and a compatible driver are configured. It hands control back for text entry, uncertain decisions, risky operations or driver errors.

## Building from source

`cargo run build` now builds a local desktop executable once, without a watcher or installer. A dependency-free launcher avoids compiling the headless CLI just to start the build, and unchanged frontend assets retain their timestamps to preserve Rust's incremental cache.

`cargo run build-win` builds the WinUI 3 preview on Windows; `cargo run build-mac` builds the SwiftUI app on macOS. These local shortcuts default to Debug and accept `--release`. **Published installers and release CI continue to use release optimization.** See [build instructions](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.17.0/docs/development.md).

Native previews are still not feature-complete. SwiftUI Preview requires macOS 13+, installs alongside the regular app and shares its project data, settings and keyring. It updates by manual download. The regular WebView app and its updater remain available.

# wisp-science v1.17.0 — 研究助理

**用一条长期对话管理研究计划，把具体工作交给项目，并在桌面或微信中接收结果。**

新增的**科研助理**把项目活动、已保存计划和任务派发放进同一条持续对话。你可以询问本周进展、记下今天的安排，或把明确任务发给某个项目里的对话。助理负责组织，项目 Agent 负责实际分析。本版本还带来了每日研究回顾、自动化页面、可配置钩子，以及对话操作和原生桌面预览版的改进。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的 DMG 安装包，签名并公证；兼容版本可在应用内更新。
- **macOS SwiftUI 预览版**：独立的 Apple Silicon 与 Intel DMG 安装包，签名并公证，各附 SHA-256 校验文件。
- **Windows**：MSI 与 NSIS 安装包。目前正式签名仍关闭，安装包暂未签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。

各平台构建完成后，安装包会陆续出现在 Assets。Windows WinUI 3 预览版仍通过 native-preview 工作流产物或本地源码构建获取，不替代常规 Windows 安装包。

## 研究助理

- 从首页打开**科研助理**，原有临时对话入口由它取代。在同一条长期对话中跨项目工作，项目列表和日历侧栏可分别收起；窄窗口使用抽屉。
- 询问可见项目的已记录进展，或选择一个项目，让后续提问带上该项目已保存的对话。隐私模式隐藏的项目对助理不可见。
- 保存带日期的计划，标记待办、完成或放弃。未完成条目会顺延到今天，计划不会因对话压缩而丢失。
- 列出项目对话，继续已有对话或新建任务对话。派发前可按要求设置默认服务器；忙碌对话不会被打断或更换服务器。
- 项目 Agent 接收任务后，助理先确认启动并恢复可用。项目本轮结束后，后台回报会把结果、输出文件、失败和未完成事项写回助理对话。
- 派发任务遇到项目审批时，会按原始请求判断。范围明确且详情充分的操作可批准一次，不确定或信息不足的请求交给你处理。助理完全权限不会授予整个项目完全权限。

助理本身不编辑文件、不执行命令、不检索文献，这些工作由项目 Agent 完成。详见[研究助理说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.17.0/docs/research-assistant.md)与[使用教程](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-research-assistant.html)。

## 微信接入

- **科研助理 → 远程接入**提供独立、默认关闭的微信 iLink 绑定。微信消息直接进入桌面上的同一条助理对话，无需用斜杠命令切换项目。
- 助理绑定与设置中的项目机器人相互独立。同一个机器人同一时间只能属于一个入口，只接收绑定所有者的私聊消息。
- 回复 `yes` / `no` 处理当前审批，使用 `full` / `full off` 开关助理会话的临时完全权限，`/approval` 可再次显示待审批请求。完全权限重启后失效。
- 微信发起的工作完成后，会向原绑定回传摘要。`/status`、`/help`、`/stop` 只作用于助理入口。

远程接入和完成回报需要 Wisp 保持运行。iLink 回复窗口失效时，摘要先保存在桌面，并等待同一连接中的下一条消息后补发；退出应用或解除绑定可能丢弃尚未发送的内存通知。Agent 本轮结束不代表另外提交的长时间计算任务已经完成。

## 回顾、自动化与钩子

- 新增**自动化**页面，集中管理项目定时任务和每日研究回顾。可创建每天、每周或固定间隔任务，也可暂停或立即运行。
- 每日回顾默认开启，时间为 09:00。为最近三个完整日中有活动、尚无回顾的日子生成草稿，错过后补跑，不覆盖已有或已忽略的回顾。草稿需审阅确认后才成为正式研究记录。
- Archive 与 Recap 可以绑定各自的专家模型。归档审阅可在准备或确认过程中最小化。
- **设置 → 钩子**管理内置钩子和命令钩子。项目 `.wisp/hooks.json` 必须先信任当前内容，修改后需要重新信任；支持 JSON 决策，`PreToolUse` 钩子失败时会阻止工具执行。

定时任务只在 Wisp 打开时运行，不是操作系统级后台服务。

## 对话与桌面改进

- 未发送草稿跟随各自的对话保存。助理发送失败时保留草稿和已选项目。
- 独立的思考强度控件使用模型 ID 精确对应的能力。统一发送/停止按钮、副对话图标和输入框菜单；窄工具栏把操作收进“更多”。
- 点击已就绪的附件即可打开预览。移动或删除对话产物文件前，会显示受影响文件的预览。
- 收起的会话可以从搜索中过滤，并在之后恢复。命令与搜索面板使用更一致的样式和快捷键提示。
- 修复 macOS 输入框方向键插入控制字符、旧数据库字段导致项目创建失败，以及某个项目数据库不可用时阻塞其他正常会话的问题。
- 新增正式的 **Sign in with ChatGPT**，同时保留 Codex 登录作为旧版选项。
- 刷新离线构建和模型能力精确匹配使用的内置 models.dev 目录。
- SwiftUI 预览版改进代码高亮和用量显示。WinUI 3 改进宿主启动、项目导航反馈、对话阅读、面板、Run 审阅和输入框选项。
- 可选的 `desktop_autopilot` 在配置 TypeSafe 凭据和兼容的 Cua Driver 后，用 Jev 的判断驱动桌面操作。遇到文本输入、不确定判断、风险操作或驱动错误时，会交回控制权。

## 源码构建

`cargo run build` 现在一次性生成本地桌面程序，不启动源码监听或打包安装器。无依赖的轻量入口避免为了启动构建而先编译整个命令行 Agent；内容未变化的前端产物保留时间戳，复用 Rust 增量缓存。

`cargo run build-win` 在 Windows 上构建 WinUI 3 预览版，`cargo run build-mac` 在 macOS 上构建 SwiftUI 应用。本地快捷入口默认 Debug，并支持 `--release`。**正式安装包及发布 CI 继续使用 release 优化。**详见[构建说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.17.0/docs/development.md)。

原生预览版尚未完全覆盖常规版本功能。SwiftUI 预览版要求 macOS 13+，与常规应用并存，共用项目数据、设置和密钥环，通过手动下载更新。常规 WebView 应用及其更新器仍可使用。
